title: groupeval: evaluation that respects the group structure benchmarks actually have
description:
Tools for benchmarks built from groups — video frames of one lesion, slices of one scan, crops of one slide, images of one patient — where scores are conventionally reported as if every file were an independent observation.

Provides exact duplicate audits, group-disjoint split construction with leakage assertions, cluster-bootstrap and paired intervals, and a variance decomposition that separates “needs more compute” from “needs more data”.

MIT-licensed and numpy-only. This is the reference implementation accompanying an independent audit of the standard polyp segmentation benchmark.
